full_prompt_en: A square surreal painting shows a colossal face-like profile carved into or emerging from a vertical stone wall on the right, above an immense empty plain. The wall rises beyond the top edge and descends to the lower right, its cracked ocher-gray surface broken into irregular slabs. Near the center, a deep horizontal notch forms an eye socket; below it, a projecting ridge reads as a nose and a smaller dark opening suggests a mouth. The facial form is ambiguous enough to remain part of the cliff, yet its profile against the open left side is unmistakable. At the wall's foot, three tiny dark human silhouettes stand close together, barely reaching the lower portion of the face. Their scale turns the stone into an overwhelming monument. The left half of the image is mostly misty sky, moving from cool gray-green at the top to muted golden light near a very low horizon. Across the bottom, a wide flat reddish-brown ground plane stretches toward the figures, marked by fine horizontal texture and soft patches of shadow. A dark plume of haze falls along the cliff's left edge, partly concealing where rock meets sky. The viewpoint is low and distant, holding the whole encounter in a still, almost empty landscape. The painted surface has mottled grain and fissures, and the atmospheric gradient is soft rather than glossy. Light appears to come from low on the left horizon, gilding a few protruding stone planes while the recesses and right edge sink into brown-black shadow. No readable text appears. The overall composition is spare and unsettling, opposing a vast weathered vertical mass to luminous empty space and a handful of minute witnesses.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形超现实绘画中，一张巨大的侧面面孔仿佛从右边竖直石壁里雕出或显现，下方是一片辽阔空地。石壁越过上边缘，向右下方延伸，赭灰色龟裂表面分成不规则石块。中央附近一条深深的水平缺口形成眼窝；其下突起的棱线像鼻子，较小的暗口暗示嘴巴。面容仍有足够的含糊感，保留为崖壁的一部分，但它在左侧空地前的侧影又清晰无误。墙脚三个人形小小深色剪影紧挨着站立，身高只到面部下方一点；这样的尺度把石墙变成压倒性的纪念碑。左半幅几乎都是雾状天空，从顶部冷灰绿过渡到很低的地平线附近低调的金光。下方一大片平坦红棕地面伸向人影，带有细水平纹理与柔软暗影。深色雾流沿崖壁左缘下落，局部遮掩石头与天空的接处。视点低而远，将整场相遇置于静止且几乎空无的景观里。绘画表面有斑驳颗粒与裂缝，大气渐层柔软而非光滑发亮。光似乎来自左侧低地平线，为少数突出的石面镀金，凹处与右缘则沉入棕黑阴影。画面没有可读文字。整体构图疏朗而令人不安，以巨大风化的竖向体量对照发亮的空阔空间和寥寥几个微小见证者。
style_prompt_en: The image has a weathered surreal-painting surface where immense forms emerge ambiguously from cracked, mottled material. Jagged edges and deep recesses interrupt broad near-vertical planes; fine fissures and granular staining make the large mass feel ancient and eroded. Smoky gray-green, muted ocher, rusty brown, and low gold form a narrow desaturated palette. Light gathers near a low horizon and grazes selected protrusions, leaving hollows almost black while soft haze dissolves distant boundaries. Vast open areas are set against one concentrated dark mass, with tiny marks establishing an extreme scale relationship. The viewpoint remains still and low, and the texture is painterly rather than mechanically smooth. The overall effect is dreamlike, ominous, and monumental, relying on ambiguity, atmospheric distance, and severe imbalance between open space and weight.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有风化的超现实绘画表面，巨大形体从龟裂斑驳材质中暧昧地显现。锯齿边缘和深凹空隙打断宽阔近乎竖直的平面；细裂缝与颗粒污色让大体量显得古老而受侵蚀。烟灰绿、低调赭色、铁锈棕与暗金构成狭窄低饱和色域。光聚在低地平线附近，擦亮选定凸起部分，凹处几乎全黑，柔雾则融解远处边界。辽阔开放区域与一处集中的深色体量相对，微小笔迹建立悬殊尺度关系。视点稳定而低，纹理保留绘画感而非机械平滑。整体效果如梦、不祥且宏伟，依靠含糊性、大气距离和空旷与重量之间的严峻失衡。
theme_en: Tiny silhouettes beneath a colossal eroded face emerging from a stone wall at dusk
theme_zh: 暮色中微小人影站在从石壁显现的巨大风蚀面孔下
name: Zdzislaw Beksinski
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
